title: Architecture
description: The boot chain from firmware to the desktop, and the directories each piece lives in.
hast: Palmy is modelled on Alpine: a small static busybox userland, a package manager with a world file and signed indexes, and very little else. What is its own is written in Odin: the init, the login daemon, the package manager and its root daemon, and, on the palmy toolkit, the window manager, the greeter, the installer and the applications.
From firmware to a desktop, as
builds it. Every box is a process or a stage; the line under each name is what it is or where it lives.
